steps.label: Probe the scroll container geometry
steps.name: scrollContainer
steps.script: return (() => { const body = document.getElementById('gxui20-hwbwkw01-Gxui_layoutmenu-Center-body'); if (!body) return { error: 'body not found' }; const cs = getComputedStyle(body); const r = body.getBoundingClientRect(); const innerCt = document.getElementById('gxui20-hwbwkw01-Gxui_layoutmenu-Center-innerCt'); return { scrollContainer: { id: body.id, overflowY: cs.overflowY, clientHeight: body.clientHeight, scrollHeight: body.scrollHeight, scrollTop: body.scrollTop, hasScrollbar: body.scrollHeight > body.clientHeight, boundingRect: { x: Math.round(r.x), y: Math.round(r.y), width: Math.round(r.width), height: Math.round(r.height) } }, innerCt: innerCt ? { clientHeight: innerCt.clientHeight, scrollHeight: innerCt.scrollHeight, childCount: innerCt.children.length, children: [...innerCt.children].map(c => ({ id: c.id || null, tag: c.tagName.toLowerCase(), className: String(c.className || '').slice(0, 60), clientHeight: c.clientHeight, scrollHeight: c.scrollHeight, display: getComputedStyle(c).display, visibility: getComputedStyle(c).visibility })) } : null }; })();

steps.label: Count ALL sub-menu items including those below fold
steps.name: allSubMenuItems
steps.script: return (() => { const selectors = ['#gxui20-hwbwkw01-Gxui_layoutmenu-Center .x-grid-row', '#gxui20-hwbwkw01-Gxui_layoutmenusearch-Center .x-grid-row', '[id*="MENU1"] .x-grid-row', '[id*="MENU2"] .x-grid-row']; let rows = []; let usedSelector = ''; for (const s of selectors) { const found = [...document.querySelectorAll(s)]; if (found.length > 0) { rows = found; usedSelector = s; break; } } const vp = window.innerHeight; const scrollBody = document.getElementById('gxui20-hwbwkw01-Gxui_layoutmenu-Center-body'); return { selectorUsed: usedSelector, totalItems: rows.length, scrollBodyClientHeight: scrollBody ? scrollBody.clientHeight : null, scrollBodyScrollHeight: scrollBody ? scrollBody.scrollHeight : null, items: rows.map((r, i) => { const rect = r.getBoundingClientRect(); return { index: i, text: (r.innerText || '').trim().slice(0, 80), y: Math.round(rect.y), bottom: Math.round(rect.bottom), height: Math.round(rect.height), visible: rect.top >= 0 && rect.bottom <= vp, belowFold: rect.top > vp, aboveFold: rect.bottom < 0 }; }) }; })();
